events.title: The Wrong Side of the Label

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Please tell me you haven't stepped on the little pink paper star. That's the only one I got the cut right on.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Is this for a tournament?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: A showcase. Deck boxes, playmats, stuff you can actually touch. The shop said I can borrow one table if nothing smells like paint.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Your designs look good.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: They're mine, which isn't quite the same. People keep asking whether someone else drew them.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Sorry. That got serious. Want to help me make the display not look like a yard sale?

choices.label: Help arrange the display by color
choices.reply: You have excellent taste. Don't let that go to your head; I need you to hold this corner.

choices.label: Ask why she has to prove the designs are hers
choices.reply: Because 'cute' gets called a hobby and 'serious' gets called a business. I want them to be both.

choices.label: Tell her her work is hard to ignore
choices.reply: Careful. My ego barely fits under this cap already. ...Thanks, though.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Don't look at the score machine. I just won a game with a deck box that's held together by tape.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Are you testing it in the arcade?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Field test. Official scientific term for dropping things on purpose.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: And the problem?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: A store wants fifty units with their logo covering mine. Fifty is a lot. My name disappearing is also a lot.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I could use someone to argue with me instead of saying whatever sounds nice.

choices.label: Suggest negotiating a small co-branded run
choices.reply: Okay. So it's not no, it's a different yes. I can work with that.

choices.label: Ask what matters more: cash or the signature
choices.reply: Both. That's the annoying part. I can want rent money and still want to be proud of the work.

choices.label: Say her signature belongs where people can see it
choices.reply: Well, now I really have to design a signature worth staring at, don't I?

openingByFlag.barb_display_help: You helped me make the display. Guess who noticed the arrangement? The buyer with the giant logo.
openingByFlag.barb_display_why: You asked why I care about authorship. A buyer just made that question complicated.
openingByFlag.barb_display_flirt: You said my work was hard to ignore. A shop noticed it and is now trying to cover my name.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I made a mockup. Then another. Then twelve more. None of them felt like me.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You sound tired.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I can stay up all night fixing a seam. Turns out you can't seam-rip a decision.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Have you told the buyer you're uncomfortable?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I wrote the message three times. Saved the draft. Deleted the draft. Classic me.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I'm not asking you to solve this. Just don't pretend it isn't scary.

choices.label: Sit with her while she writes the message
choices.reply: You didn't touch the keyboard. You just stayed. I think that's why I could hit send.

choices.label: Admit you would be afraid to send it too
choices.reply: Good. I thought everyone else had some secret bravery manual.

choices.label: Tell her being nervous makes her courage matter more
choices.reply: That was unfairly sweet. I was prepared for sarcasm. Give me a second.

openingByFlag.barb_prototype_negotiate: I tried writing the co-branding proposal you suggested. It's sitting in my drafts.
openingByFlag.barb_prototype_values: Remember when I said I wanted both? I think I have to say it out loud to the buyer.
openingByFlag.barb_prototype_signature: My signature is still on the mockup. I just need to convince myself I can ask for it.

events.title: The Table With Her Name On It

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I have exactly three minutes before the showcase opens, and the table banner is upside down.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Want a hand?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Yes—please don't laugh. They said yes to the smaller run with both logos.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You did it.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: We did the argument part. I had to do the sending part. My hands shook like I was flipping for turn one.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: What if everyone likes the work, then asks somebody taller and louder who made it?

choices.label: Stand beside her but let her introduce the work
choices.reply: I kept expecting you to step in. You didn't. That felt like you believed I could do it.

choices.label: Help turn the banner right-side up and rehearse
choices.reply: A thirty-second rehearsal. A huge difference. You're welcome at my table any time.

choices.label: Say you came to cheer for the artist, not the display
choices.reply: Stop. I'm going to smile at the wrong time and embarrass myself in front of customers.

openingByFlag.barb_cafe_stay: You sat with me while I sent the message. They answered. Here we are.
openingByFlag.barb_cafe_honest: You said you would be scared too. I sent it scared. Turns out that counts.
openingByFlag.barb_cafe_courage: I kept what you said in my head when I finally hit send. Don't get smug about it.

events.title: A Design With Space Left Open

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I brought my sketchbook, but I haven't drawn a single line. I'm trying a new thing called 'having a day off.'

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: How's it going?

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: Terribly. I keep measuring clouds for card sleeves.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: At least things are moving with your designs.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: They are. And I realized I don't want every choice made for me, even the nice ones.

lines.speaker: barb
lines.text: I can keep making room for my work. I think I might want to make room for someone, too. No pressure for either of us.

choices.label: Tell her you value the quiet days too
choices.reply: Then we can leave the next page blank for a while. I think I'd like that.

choices.label: Say you will respect the time she needs
choices.reply: Good. I like someone who knows an invitation isn't an obligation.

choices.label: Ask if she wants to explore something more together
choices.reply: I do. Slowly, on purpose, with actual communication. This is extremely off-brand for me.

openingByFlag.barb_showcase_space: Thanks for letting me speak for myself at the showcase. I'm still thinking about that.
openingByFlag.barb_showcase_practice: The rehearsal worked. Turns out I can introduce my own work without swallowing my words.
openingByFlag.barb_showcase_artist: You made me grin through my whole showcase. That is an official complaint.
